source.name: CEPII BACI
source.citation: Gaulier, G. and Zignago, S. (2010). BACI: International Trade Database at the Product-Level. CEPII Working Paper N°2010-23.

baskets.label: Integrated circuits (chips)
baskets.rationale: Core semiconductor dependency question. The HS12 sub-headings separate processors, memories and amplifiers. Taiwan is reported as "Other Asia, nes" (BACI code 490 / S19) and must be labelled clearly in every view.
caveats: Parts (854290) are excluded; this basket covers finished ICs only.
Re-exports through hubs (e.g. Hong Kong, Singapore) inflate apparent supplier roles.

baskets.label: Lithium-ion accumulators
baskets.rationale: Clean single HS6 code in HS12 for a key energy-transition good.
caveats: Includes cells and battery packs; cannot separate EV packs from consumer cells.

baskets.label: Lithium chemicals (carbonate, hydroxide/oxide)
baskets.rationale: Upstream inputs to Li-ion; geographically very concentrated refining.
caveats: Lithium ores/concentrates have no dedicated HS12 code (no HS12 description mentions lithium ore; spodumene is commonly reported under the residual heading 253090), so this basket excludes them.

baskets.label: Rare-earth compounds, metals and permanent magnets
baskets.rationale: Classic concentration case; magnets connect to motors and wind turbines.
caveats: 850511 covers ALL metal permanent magnets, not only NdFeB rare-earth magnets.
Values are small and volatile; check value vs tonnes divergence.

baskets.label: Antibiotics (bulk active ingredients)
baskets.rationale: Pharmaceutical-input dependency; bulk APIs rather than finished medicines.
caveats: Finished medicaments (3003/3004) are excluded; their value is dominated by branded products.

baskets.label: Green coffee (control basket)
baskets.rationale: An ordinary product with a well-understood supplier structure. It is used to sanity-check the metrics and to stop "dependency" findings from being presented without comparison.

notes: Shares use each importer's imports from ALL partner countries.
Absent flows are 'not recorded', not zero.
Country code 490 / ISO3 S19 is 'Other Asia, nes' (Taiwan).
redirectable_kusd is an observed upper bound, not feasible substitution.
